description: Structured Pydantic schema for ValuePropositionAnalyzer agent output.

core_value_proposition.description: Clear, 1-2 sentence core value proposition statement.
core_value_proposition.title: Core Value Proposition

unique_selling_proposition.description: Unique selling proposition (USP) highlighting the primary differentiator.
unique_selling_proposition.title: Unique Selling Proposition

functional_benefits.description: Tangible functional benefits (e.g., faster diagnostic speed, automated reporting).
functional_benefits.title: Functional Benefits

emotional_benefits.description: Psychological or emotional benefits (e.g., peace of mind, confidence in decisions).
emotional_benefits.title: Emotional Benefits

customer_outcomes.description: Quantifiable customer outcomes and results (e.g. 50% faster diagnosis time).
customer_outcomes.title: Customer Outcomes

differentiators.description: Key competitive differentiators and value moats.
differentiators.title: Differentiators

value_clarity_score.description: Clarity rating of the value proposition from 0 (confusing) to 100 (crystal clear).
value_clarity_score.title: Value Clarity Score

customer_value_score.description: Estimated customer value rating score from 0 to 100.
customer_value_score.title: Customer Value Score

confidence_score.description: Analysis confidence rating score from 0 to 100.
confidence_score.title: Confidence Score

title: ValuePropositionAnalysis
